# govengers/auth

> Authentication and authorization for Go services: password (Argon2id, TOTP), OIDC (Keycloak enrichment, Google), GitHub OAuth with teams, API keys and JWT all produce one `auth.Identity`; redirect and password logins keep it in a server-side session that one `session.Guard` turns into a request context identity (401 JSON for APIs, 302 to the login for UIs); authorization is `authorization.Check`, a `func(context.Context) error` over that identity. Core packages are `net/http` only; gin and Prometheus live in adapter packages. Also ships the forward-auth image `ghcr.io/govengers/forwardauth` for Traefik.

- Module: `github.com/govengers/auth` (v1), Go 1.26, Apache 2.0.
- Packages: `auth` (root), `session`, `session/redisbackend`, `password`, `oidc`, `oidc/keycloak`, `github`, `apikey`, `jwt`, `authorization`, `ginadapter`, `prometheusadapter`; binary `cmd/forwardauth`.
- Constructors are `New(options *Options) (*X, error)` and validate at startup; components never log and never start goroutines, they report to an optional `auth.Observer`.
- Errors: `*auth.Error` with `errors.Is` kinds `auth.ErrUnauthenticated`, `ErrForbidden`, `ErrInvalidRequest`, `ErrConflict`; one JSON body `{"code","message"}`.
- Standards: govengers/standards, `library` profile (`.govengers.yml`); service rules also apply to `cmd/forwardauth` and `internal/forwardauth`.

## Docs

- [Home](docs/wiki/Home.md): model, package map, which package for which need, wiring order.
- [Password](docs/wiki/Password.md): password login, `password.Storage`, TOTP, registration, routes, codes.
- [OIDC](docs/wiki/OIDC.md): OIDC login and logout, options, Keycloak enrichment, Google.
- [GitHub](docs/wiki/GitHub.md): GitHub OAuth, teams, admin role, refresh, API client.
- [Sessions](docs/wiki/Sessions.md): `Store`, `Guard`, cookie naming, refresh, memory and Redis backends.
- [Authorization](docs/wiki/Authorization.md): identity fields, roles, permissions, checks, net/http check middleware, own checks.
- [JWT](docs/wiki/JWT.md): `jwt.Verifier` in backends, `jwt.Signer`.
- [API-Keys](docs/wiki/API-Keys.md): static keys, `Resolver`, ordering with the Guard.
- [Gin](docs/wiki/Gin.md): `ginadapter`, wide events, `prometheusadapter`.
- [Errors-and-Observability](docs/wiki/Errors-and-Observability.md): `auth.Error`, `ResponseFor`, `Observer`, `Outcome`.
- [Forward-Auth](docs/wiki/Forward-Auth.md): the image in short: what it does, minimum configuration, the Traefik rules that matter.
- [Forward-Auth-Configuration](docs/wiki/Forward-Auth-Configuration.md): docker compose, TLS and Kubernetes wiring, routes, every environment variable, the JWT claims, operations.
- [Security](docs/wiki/Security.md): cookie, session, OAuth, redirect, credential and JWT guarantees, known limits.
- [Gotchas](docs/wiki/Gotchas.md): the non-obvious rules, one line each.

## Examples

- [examples/password/main.go](examples/password/main.go): net/http server with password login, registration, TOTP, an admin role from `OnLogin`, API and UI routes, logout.
- [examples/oidc/main.go](examples/oidc/main.go): net/http server with OIDC login, optional Keycloak enrichment, a realm role check, logout at the IdP.
- [examples/github/main.go](examples/github/main.go): gin server with GitHub login, team-based admin check, wide-event recording, logout.
- Each `main_test.go` runs a full login against the in-repo fakes; package `Example*` functions live in each package's `example_test.go`.
